name: Algebraic Matrix Trace Obfuscation
description: Transforms the graph independent set condition into a linear algebra constraint. The problem asks for a boolean assignment that makes the trace of the square of a specifically constructed symmetric matrix exactly equal to k. This requires the model to symbolically expand the trace formula and deduce that it simplifies to k + 2 * sum(z_u * z_v), which equals k if and only if no two connected variables are both 1 (the exact independent set condition). Models failing this deduction will attempt naive matrix simulation and TLE.
